title: Fractional Power-of-Two Quantization for Efficient and Effective Multiplier-Free LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.21257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demand efficient inference, where the multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations in linear projections dominate compute and energy cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost by mapping weights and activations to low-bit integers. Power-of-Two (PoT) weight quantization promises efficient multiplier-free LLM inference via shift-add logic, but suffers significant accuracy degradation at low bitwidths due to its coarse base-2 quantization grid. We introduce Fractional PoT (FPoT), a base-$\sqrt{2}$ (half-octave) fractional PoT grid that achieves practical 4-bit weight quantization while preserving a fully integer shift-add datapath. The method combines (i) the base-$\sqrt{2}$ weight grid with uniform integer activations, (ii) a calibration-time grid-alignment refinement absorbed into the static per-channel scale, and (iii) a lightweight 1-adder $\sqrt{2}$ approximation whose error is absorbed during weig

translated_title: 面向高效且有效的无乘法器LLM推理的分数二次幂量化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）需要高效的推理，其中线性投影中的乘累加（MAC）运算主导了计算和能耗成本。训练后量化（PTQ）通过将权重和激活映射到低位整数来降低这一成本。二次幂权重量化通过移位-加法逻辑有望实现高效的无乘法器LLM推理，但由于其粗糙的以2为基数的量化网格，在低位宽下会出现显著的精度下降。我们引入了分数二次幂量化（FPoT），这是一种以√2为基数（半八度）的分数二次幂网格，在保持完全整数移位-加法数据通路的同时，实现了实用的4位权重量化。该方法结合了：(i) 以√2为基数的权重网格与均匀整数激活相结合，(ii) 在校准阶段进行并被吸收到静态逐通道缩放因子中的网格对齐细化，以及 (iii) 轻量级的单加法器√2近似，其误差在权重量化过程中被吸收。
tldr: 该论文提出分数二次幂量化（FPoT），采用以√2为基数的半八度分数量化网格，在保持完全整数移位-加法数据通路实现无乘法器推理的同时，解决了传统二次幂量化在低位宽下的精度下降问题，实现了实用的4位LLM权重量化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Fractional Power-of-Two (FPoT) quantization, a base-√2 half-octave quantization grid that achieves practical 4-bit weight quantization while preserving a fully integer shift-add datapath for multiplier-free LLM inference, addressing the accuracy degradation of traditional Power-of-Two quantization at low bitwidths.
